immediate_actions: do not copy prohibited raw payload into logs
invalidate any pending build or release authorization
record only classification, timestamp, bounded impact, artifact fingerprints, and human decision
do not contact additional people or broaden the source
stop_triggers: major reader confusion after one bounded correction
request for code write, publication, delivery, pricing, contract, invoice, or other external authority

withdrawal_effect.restart: Requires a new intake and a new explicit human authorization.
withdrawal_effect.retained_material: Only consent decision, source/artifact fingerprints, and non-sensitive audit metadata permitted.
